All files here are generated by tests/make_fixtures.py and are synthetic.
say_*.aiff are macOS text-to-speech output (synthetic speech, NOT natural speech; no reference
contour exists). *.webm / *.mp4 are PyAV encodes of the wav fixtures; *_truncated.* are byte-cut
copies (first 60 % of the file) to simulate an interrupted upload.

silence.wav: 2 s digital silence
low_noise.wav: 2 s Gaussian white noise at -60 dBFS RMS
white_noise.wav: 2 s Gaussian white noise at -12 dBFS RMS
sine_110.wav: 2 s pure sine 110 Hz, amplitude 0.5
sine_220.wav: 2 s pure sine 220 Hz, amplitude 0.5
sine_330.wav: 2 s pure sine 330 Hz, amplitude 0.5
harmonic_140.wav: 2 s harmonic complex 140 Hz, 10 harmonics with 1/k amplitudes
harmonic_240.wav: 2 s harmonic complex 240 Hz, 10 harmonics with 1/k amplitudes
glide_150_300.wav: 2 s exponential glide 150 -> 300 Hz, harmonic complex
clipped_200.wav: 2 s 200 Hz sine with gain 3, hard-clipped at full scale
mixed_voiced_unvoiced.wav: silence 0.5 | 200 Hz tone 0.5 | noise 0.3 | silence 0.2 | 180 Hz tone 0.7 | noise 0.3 | silence 0.5 (s)
octave_jump.wav: harmonic complex 200 Hz with a 0.8 s section at 400 Hz (0.6 - 1.4 s; real octave changes in the signal)
octave_jump_short.wav: harmonic complex 200 Hz with a 0.3 s section at 400 Hz (0.9 - 1.2 s; real octave changes in the signal)
